figurative_meaning_bn: প্রচুর আদরযত্ন; উৎকৃষ্ট ও ভূরিভোজনে সমাদর
figurative_meaning_en: Excessive pampering and care; excellent hospitality with lavish food and honor
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের পর নতুন জামাইকে জামাই-আদর করা হয়েছে।
রাজনীতিতে দল বদলে নতুন নেতাদের জামাই-আদর দেওয়া হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: After the wedding, the new son-in-law was given the full son-in-law pampering.
In politics, leaders who switch parties often receive son-in-law treatment.
history: The idiom draws from Bengali wedding customs where the son-in-law is lavishly treated, and extends satirically to contexts like politicians switching parties and receiving undue favors.
note: Often used in familial and socio-political contexts to denote special, sometimes undeserved, treatment.
